snip.t: Nigrostriatal: Control of movement — Extrapyramidal side effects (dystonia, akathisia, parkinsonism, tardive dyskinesia)
Other effects: hyperprolactinaemia, QT prolongation, neuroleptic malignant syndrome (fever, rigidity, altered consciousness, raised creatine kinase), tardive dyskinesia with long use.
Warning for metoclopramide, linking its chronic use (longer than 3 mo) can cause tardive dyskinesia, the rarely reversible movement disorder.
Typical (first-gen): haloperidol, chlorpromazine – block D2 receptors; extrapyramidal side effects (EPS) common (akathisia, dystonia, tardive dyskinesia)
